Beach Resort follows the brand-wide cancellation policy [1]:

- **Flexible rate:** Free cancellation up to 48 hours before arrival. Cancellations within 48 hours are charged one night plus tax.
- **Non-refundable rate:** No refunds or date changes under any circumstances, except when approved by the General Manager.

Note: The spa has its own cancellation policy—cancellations within 12 hours are charged 50% of the treatment price [5].
